mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Rusty Departures/PT Rusty to Bayside (~360°)
instructions: Remain clear of Goliad arrival traffic at 2,500' MSL between Woodsboro and Bayside

cards.title: Abeam Bayside
mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Rusty Departures/Bayside to Goliad (~322°)
instructions: Turn direct to NOLF Goliad, HDG ~322°
Climb or descend to 4,500 ft or 6,500' MSL

cards.title: Leave Corpus Departure
cards.leadIn: When Corpus Departure terminates radar service:

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, leaving my airspace to the north, radar services are terminated, squawk appropriate code, frequency change approved.

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: <callsign>, squawk appropriate code, frequency change approved.
